newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Nov domestic production up 29.2% y/y.
newsitem.headline: Honda Nov domestic production up 29.2% y/y.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday that its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in November rose as follows (with percentage comparisons from a year ago):
Honda's domestic output rose in November for the fifth consecutive month on a year-on-year basis, mainly due to higher domestic sales and an increase in exports of Civics to North America.
Honda's domestic sales rose for the 23rd successive month on a year-on-year basis, due to robust demand for its Odyssey and Step Wagon recreational vehicles and for its new compact hatchback Logo.
Exports rose for the third month in a row, mainly reflecting higher exports of Civic sedans to North America, as its U.S. plant could not keep up with strong demand.
Overseas production rose for the 10th consecutive month due to higher output in North America and Asia.
